audit_findings.finding: Scaler is fitted before holdout/split in visible paths; validation distribution leaks into preprocessing parameters.
Paper describes per-tree error weighting; visible main RF code uses standard sklearn aggregation. Treat weighted-RF claim as unverified unless omitted code is supplied.
Visible classifier returns probabilities via softmax and feeds them to CrossEntropyLoss, which expects logits.
Paper states SINR depends on other rows from the same experiment, so row-random splitting can leak experiment context across train/validation.

required_future_replication: explicit PHY-rate to MCS/NSS mapping table
